originalTitle: Is 'Trumpflation' real? Why Wall Street fears this could be a reason for stock market crash
simplifiedContent: There's a worry on Wall Street that something called "Trumpflation" might cause the stock market to go down. This concern is growing because of two main things: prices are rising steadily (inflation is at 3.3%) and the interest rates on government loans (Treasury yields) are going up. This could lead the Federal Reserve to keep interest rates high or even raise them, which would make it more expensive for companies to borrow money and could hurt the stock market. As a result, the high prices of stocks might not be sustainable, which is why some people are worried about a potential market crash. This is a problem because it could affect the value of the stocks that people own.

originalTitle: World Bank's IFC, HDFC AMC invest in Molbio Diagnostics' Rs 281 crore IPO anchor round
simplifiedContent: Molbio Diagnostics, a company based in Goa, is planning to raise money by selling shares to the public, known as an Initial Public Offering (IPO). Before the IPO opens on August 10, the company has already raised Rs 281 crore from big investors, including the World Bank's IFC and HDFC Mutual Fund. This is called an "anchor round" and it's a sign that these important investors believe in the company. The company also made Rs 160 crore from selling shares to other investors. This investment is significant because it shows that major investors are interested in Molbio Diagnostics, which might encourage others to invest when the IPO opens.

originalTitle: Market Trading Guide: Jindal Saw among 2 stock recommendations for Monday
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the news: Some companies in the stock market have recently released their financial results, and most of them have done as well as or better than expected. This is making investors feel more positive about certain areas of the market. As a result, some experts are recommending that investors consider buying specific stocks, including Jindal Saw, on Monday. This could be a good opportunity for investors to make some money, but it's always important to do your own research before making any decisions. The overall mood in the market is optimistic, which could help these recommended stocks do well.

originalTitle: The stock market is finally rising again—and it’s getting cheaper, too
simplifiedContent: The stock market, which is measured by the S&P 500, has been doing well and has gone up by 22% in the last year. Even though the market is rising, the prices of stocks are actually becoming more affordable, which is called a decrease in valuation. This means that investors can buy stocks at a lower price compared to the company's earnings. This is a positive sign for investors, as it makes the stock market a more attractive place to put their money. Overall, the combination of a rising market and decreasing valuations is a good thing for people who want to invest in stocks.

originalTitle: Upcoming IPOs: Shiprocket IPO, Dhoot Transmission IPO among new issues to open next week; full list here
simplifiedContent: Some companies, including Shiprocket and Dhoot Transmission, are planning to sell their shares to the public for the first time through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This means that people can buy their shares and become part owners of the company. These IPOs are scheduled to start between August 10 and 12. At the same time, shares of eight other companies that started selling last week will begin trading on the market. This is important because it gives investors new opportunities to buy shares in these companies.

originalTitle: Defence stock Apollo Micro Systems declares Q1 results 2026. Revenue jumps 88% YoY to  ₹251 crore, PAT up 43%
simplifiedContent: Apollo Micro Systems, a company that makes products for the defense industry, just released its financial results for the first quarter of 2026. The company's revenue, which is the total amount of money it made from selling its products, increased by 88% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹251.3 crore. Its net profit, which is the amount of money it made after paying all its expenses, also increased by 43% to ₹25.2 crore. This is a significant increase and indicates that the company is growing and performing well. This matters because it can affect the company's stock price and make it more attractive to investors.
